purpose: Test whether Stage 5B model familiarity predicts historical OOF error, conditionally calibrate displayed uncertainty widths, and surface disagreements among grade, calibrated hit rate, classifier probability, and nearest-neighbor outcomes.

confidence_error_test.definition: Pooled historical leave-one-out Stage 5B confidence versus absolute leakage-safe historical prospect-model OOF error.
confidence_error_test.adaptive_rule: Use confidence-specific scaling only when Spearman rho <= -0.1, p <= 0.1, at least two confidence groups have n >= 15, and q80 spread is at least 10% of overall q80.
confidence_error_test.scaling: Scale original Stage 3 position-level 80/90 bands by confidence-group historical q80/q90 divided by overall historical q80/q90, clipped to 0.75-1.35.

important_note: No probability signals are averaged. Prospect percentile remains a grade; bucket hit rate is empirical calibration; classifier hit probability is a separate supervised model; five-comp hit rate is descriptive; confidence is feature-space familiarity.
